caption: The drawing consists of a large, stylized animal with four legs, an elongated body, a curled tail, and upward-pointing ears, with its body colored in shades of blue and outlined in darker blue or black lines. The animal stands on a shaded, irregular base. In the upper left corner, there is a shaded rectangular area containing the number “3” and some faint, partially legible text. Below this shaded section, there is a smaller, white rectangular box with a simple line drawing of a jug or bottle with a handle. The overall color palette consists of muted browns and grays for the background and shading, with blue tones for the figures and outlines. The drawing is bordered by a plain, off-white mat, and there is a small inscription below the jug image.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
